title: Dev Opportunity Radar #26: $85K Claude Corps Fellowship, a16z FDE Fellowship, and Reddit's $35K Game Hackathon
why_read: A roundup of fellowships, hackathons, and career opportunities, useful for job-seekers but not technically substantive.
analysis: This is a weekly curated list of career and funding opportunities for developers, including fellowships from Anthropic/CodePath and a16z, a Reddit hackathon, and various AI policy or training programs. It's a useful resource for early-career engineers or those seeking funding and visibility, but it contains no technical content, code, or research insight. It belongs more in a careers newsletter than a technical digest.
